applicant_profile.headline: Software Engineer, Network Administrator, Systems Architect, Spatial/Graphics Developer, Professional Contradictarian

federal_metadata.objective: To obtain a full-time position in public service with the FBI as a residential field agent, or to continue building client-side spatial compute engines until corporate HR algorithms give up.

applicant_profile.executive_summary: Over 24 years of programming experience spanning low-level C compilation to modern browser-based spatial/3D engines. I have systematically built, scaled, and occasionally burned down digital infrastructure across medical tech, e-commerce, game development, and educational startups. Possess a master-level understanding of cognitive bias, corporate signaling, and ATS parser limitations.

skills_and_technologies_matrix.summary: Exhaustive list of tools and concepts mastered, sorted by years of endurance.

employment_history.narrative: Refused to let legacy server architectures dictate modern UX. Engineered single-file browser IDEs, client-side WASM video transcoders, and modular Lumino layout telemetry decks without relying on bloated server compute.
highlights: Built 'ARGUS' tactical telemetry dashboard with 12 real-time widgets, SDR signal tracking, BLE tracking, GPS, dual Ryobi 18V UPS power, and OpenCV/Fast-ALPR pipelines.
Engineered client-side media server modernization replacing monolithic PHP backends with Web Workers, OPFS, WebTorrent, and FFmpeg.wasm for client-side transcoding.
Created 'quedit' and 'illustrious' spatially intelligent browser workspaces integrating WASI-SDK C compilation, Lumino dock layouts, and Ace editor workers.

employment_history.narrative: Took the legendary id Tech 3 engine (Quake III Arena) and dragged it into the 21st century web ecosystem despite legal threats and open-source licensing purists.
highlights: Bypassed native desktop installations by implementing SOCKS5 protocol and WebSockets, enabling direct browser connectivity to any native Quake 3 server.
Extracted system APIs out of Emscripten to eliminate GL emulation leaks and audio spatialization issues, doubling engine framerates from 30 FPS to 200+ FPS in-browser.
Integrated drop-in Portal geometry, cross-integrated C#/Unity/WebGPU modules into spatial pipelines, and rendered 3D map exploration tools for community platforms.

employment_history.narrative: Constructed an entire cosmetics e-commerce architecture and automated product pipeline so non-technical founders could manage live inventory using Google Sheets.
highlights: Streamlined live product delivery pipelines to update storefront inventory automatically from spreadsheet modifications.
Designed high-converting UI/UX storefront layouts optimized for beauty product merchandising.

employment_history.narrative: Built rapid-prototype web applications across modern JavaScript frameworks for startups trying to figure out what they were actually selling.
highlights: Created an ingredient-based cocktail recommendation discovery engine for Drinks.com.
Developed a dynamic localized happy-hour promotion tracker for small-town restaurant engagement.
Architected educational prototype platforms for higher education initiatives.

employment_history.narrative: Architected an online matching engine connecting tutors with students across educational institutions.
highlights: Designed matching system architecture and user workflows for educational support platforms.

employment_history.narrative: Worked 3,500 hours in a single year without taking paid time off while navigating an antiquated monolith, passive-aggressive corporate reviews, and 'unlimited PTO' psychological traps.
highlights: Built customer management buy funnels and billing storefronts integrated with Zuora and Oracle Eloqua.
Automated a manual billing validation process that saved the company $10,000+ annually, only to be told by management that the effort was 'a waste'.
Switched platform architecture from heavy C# to Node.js serverless microservices on AWS to ensure true continuous integration.

employment_history.narrative: Constructed a 3D architectural product marketplace that allowed clients to manipulate materials and AutoCAD objects live in the browser.
highlights: Engineered automated pipelines to transform CAD files into real-time interactive 3D web assets.
Implemented live customizer tools for architectural screening, directly driving new digital sales revenue.

employment_history.narrative: Developed employee wellness web platforms centered on daily meditation and mental health logging.
highlights: Implemented user interaction journals and corporate wellness subscription portals.

employment_history.narrative: Assigned to a windowless basement with anti-social contractors to remove secondary database access via request tools. Learned that corporate IBM Rational Unified Process (RUP) is where agility goes to die.
highlights: Led a team of database engineers to identify and resolve critical data access security vulnerabilities.
Exemplified corporate security failures while attempting to retrain management to approach RUP documentation holistically rather than sequentially.
Configured SharePoint Document Control Systems (DCS) linked to project artifacts.

employment_history.narrative: Managed salon setups, developed ERP/CRM logistics for international shipping, and deployed AMP-optimized e-commerce sites.
highlights: Architected international shipping logistics and ERP/CRM pipelines for specialty skincare distribution.
Built AMP-optimized e-commerce interfaces driving low-latency mobile conversions.

employment_history.narrative: Partnered with a former Marine over 3 years to design 3 distinct educational applications centered on spaced repetition, interleaving study methods, and cognitive science.
highlights: Built an online study course platform with 15 gamified lessons, A/B marketing funnels, and 24/7 engineering support.
Architected a native iOS and web spaced-repetition flashcard application implementing the Forgetting Curve algorithm.
Configured end-to-end server architecture to strictly adhere to PCI-DSS standards for transactional processing.

employment_history.narrative: Built automated testing frameworks and interactive career-focused personality testing tools for students in Ruby on Rails.
highlights: Constructed automated testing frameworks separating staging and production deployment environments.
Integrated transactional billing using Authorize.Net in Ruby on Rails.

employment_history.narrative: Re-engineered a medical device software platform analyzing mitochondrial stress via Kirlian imaging. Reduced image processing time by 6,000%, moving calculation speeds from 10 minutes to 10 milliseconds.
highlights: Rewrote matrix calculation logic using native MATLAB compilation and linear regression, enabling real-time video snapshot diagnostics.
Constructed an isolated Windows Desktop Kiosk shell to restrict workstation access and eliminate network tampering during hospital clinical trials.
Architected an on-premise cloud server using ASP.NET MVC for remote doctors to securely view patient data across hospital locations.

employment_history.narrative: Built vibrant user interfaces for an automated vulnerability scanner. Discovered zero-days and contributed to security research.
highlights: Featured on the Google Security Hall of Fame (Q2 2011) for web application vulnerability disclosures.
Participated in DEFCON vulnerability presentation showcasing automated scanning engines.
Implemented strict OWASP sink-escaping to prevent XSS and XSRF attacks.

Built initial web marketing interfaces showcasing 3D architectural products.
